primary: Five UCell -> raw major posterior mean; ring 1
p_value: native folded/minimum-tail p_sim retained; conservative min(1,2*p_sim) used for primary BH
global_BH: 252 forward primary tests; each sensitivity and reverse separate 252-test family
local_BH: per section: four partners times all valid graph-connected nodes; doubled p_sim
isolates: all analyses exclude original isolates; no fake edges; missing required values excluded then newly isolated nodes excluded; local output NA for excluded nodes
patient: only nonmissing audited patient_uid; mean per patient then bootstrap median 2000 replicates
rings: exact shortest-path rings, never cumulative; per-ring isolates excluded
